name: White dunes
summary: Pale dunes at Bàu Trắng: be on the sand from 5:00 to 7:00 for the sunrise before the heat. The field is in Hoa Thang, with steep 30-metre slopes and a lotus lake. The must-do list gives a 25 km drive. The adventure page gives a short drive from the main beach strip. Set the alarm for 4:30 if an ATV at sunrise is the plan. Midday sand is scorching.
getThere: A 25 km drive, or a short drive from the main beach strip.
heroCaption: Pale dune crests, with people small on the sand

notice.title: Be there at sunrise
notice.body: Set the alarm for 4:30 if an ATV at sunrise is the plan, and be on the sand from 5:00 to 7:00. Midday sand is scorching.

body: Climb the pale slopes at sunrise, look over the lotus lake, and sandboard the 30-metre faces. An ATV or an open jeep is the other way across the field. The adventure page sets the visit from 5:00 to 7:00 and a 4:30 alarm when the plan is an ATV at sunrise.

Midday sand is scorching, so the early window is the visit. The must-do list gives a 25 km drive. The adventure page gives a short drive from the main beach strip. The red dunes are the sunset slope. Decision 1772 calls Bàu Trắng the symbol of the national tourism zone and names Bàu Sen with it for protection.

figures.caption: Pale ridges and tracks across Bàu Trắng
figures.alt: Pale white sand ridges at Bau Trang with footprints and vehicle tracks

gettingThere: Bàu Trắng is in Hoa Thang, Bac Binh, inside the national tourism zone. The adventure page calls it a short drive from the main beach strip and prints steep 30-metre dunes and a lotus lake. The must-do list prints a 25 km drive.

legs.heading: From the Ham Tien strip
legs.body: The adventure page gives a short drive from the main beach strip. The must-do list gives a 25 km drive. Vietnam Tourism names a motorbike for the dunes. Be on the sand from 5:00 to 7:00.

admissionNote: The 5:00–7:00 window is the visit time on the adventure page. An ATV or a jeep is extra. Set the alarm for 4:30 when the plan is an ATV at sunrise. Midday sand is scorching.
